profile.summary: A nonprofit graduate school of education that recruits and prepares teachers through a residency model. Its Master's and Credential Teacher Residency lets aspiring teachers train in classrooms while earning a master's degree and teaching credential. It also offers professional education for mentor teachers. It works with public school districts, county offices of education and charter schools.
